case.title: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG. Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings. Need: 8150 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 45 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200001. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. For many years, our family foundry has taken great pride in supplying your respected company with high-quality castings from our region, and we value our long standing relationship very much.

Our team has prepared our offer carefully. We can offer you a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

To remain transparent about our situation, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. We trust that you understand the necessity of these figures for our ongoing operation and quality standards.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Brandlhuber,

Your offer speaks of a long relationship and of labour and steel costs, and we want to answer it in the same spirit: as one family company to another, with a fair price that lets both of us plan.

Let us be plain about where we stand, starting with three points.

On the notice period:
Your letter of 11 September 2026 (doc:20260911-70110-P01) gives 51 days' notice, while our contract (ctr:4600070110) requires 90 days.

On quality:
Your quality was 712 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70110@2026Q3).

On price history:
Our orders of Volute casing HN 50-200 with you were placed at EUR 128.42 on 2024-10-04 (po:4500011493-10), EUR 128.27 on 2025-06-03 (po:4500012541-10), EUR 126.53 on 2026-01-16 (po:4500013434-10) and EUR 126.53 on 2026-09-21 (po:4500014428-10): the price has not risen.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 131.59; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 30 days net.
Option B: unit price EUR 132.47; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 45 days net.
Option C: unit price EUR 133.35; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 60 days net.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives your foundry a fair step on the price, and the claims above show why it is fair.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

We remember that your foundry kept supplying us at the old price in a hard year, and we have not forgotten it. We would like to build the next years on a clear, fair agreement.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We also checked the notice period data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point.

We appreciate your open words and your recognition of our support during challenging times; as family businesses, we value this mutual respect. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

Our current Angebot is a price of €137.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

To make this extended delay possible for us, we propose a unit price of EUR 136.20 at 30 days net, which represents a substantial concession from our initial offer. As another option beside our Angebot, we can offer a price of €136.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 April 2027.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Quality Manager: We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached.

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Brandlhuber,

You wrote that we recognise your support in challenging times and that you value mutual respect as family businesses. We do, and that is why we are sending you terms that keep your shop working on a clear footing from the new price date onwards.

Thank you for checking the points we raised and for taking the quality record and the notice period into account. That is the kind of open exchange we want between our two companies.

Your current price still sits above what we can approve. Our options below are built to close that gap, and they let you choose the payment term that suits your business.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 131.87; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 30 days net.
Option B: unit price EUR 132.61; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 45 days net.
Option C: unit price EUR 133.35; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 60 days net.

Option A is the package we can approve. It pairs a fair unit price with the shortest payment term, so your money comes in sooner and the price stays steady for both of us.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We appreciate your polite response and your continued interest in finding a solution. Our family foundry has always valued the long standing relationship and close cooperation between our companies. We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. 

Please allow me to reiterate the details of our current offer for your consideration. We stand by a price of €137.80 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 60 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. Kindly note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

My team and I remain at your disposal, and we look forward to reaching a successful outcome together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Brandlhuber,

You wrote that your family foundry has always valued the long-standing relationship and close cooperation between our companies. We feel the same, and we have not forgotten that you held the old price for us in a hard year. That is why we are sending you terms that treat it as more than a courtesy.

Our options are below. They differ in price and payment term, so you can choose the one that suits your shop best.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 132.42; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 30 days net.
Option B: unit price EUR 133.16; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 45 days net.
Option C: unit price EUR 133.91; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 60 days net.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives you the quickest payment, which is the part of the deal that helps your own planning most, and it gives both of our companies a fair price on a clear footing from the new price date.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. Options B and C remain open to you if a longer payment term matters more to you.

We would like to settle this between our two family companies, without further rounds.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your improved offer and your recognition of our past support. In response to your movement, we are willing to reduce our price to EUR 135.60 for the 30 days net payment term you proposed in Option A. This is a significant step from our side to reach an agreement between our family companies.

For our complete Angebot, we state a price of €135.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Please note that our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. 

This offer is valid for 30 days. It would be an honor to continue the longstanding relationship between Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and our family foundry.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Guten Tag,

Thank you for your order. Our order confirmation is attached. It is always a pleasure to serve Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and to continue the long relationship between our companies. We take great pride in our foundry's craftsmanship and look forward to delivering the quality you expect from us.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
